The main takeaway from our work is that
the distribution theory for statistics computed from a complete data set is more complicated than the distribution theory for the same statistics when there are missing data.
the distribution of the goodness of fit statistic computed from a data set with nonresponse can be approximated by a chi-square distribution.
, in general, the asymptotic distribution of a statistic computed from a complete data set is not the same as the asymptotic distribution computed from the original data set.
